entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request establishment of services or signaling connection.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used to initiate service request procedure.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used for control plane service request procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE is idle with no active signaling connection.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE has an active signaling connection.

entities.name: 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
entities.description: 5GMM state where service request procedure has been initiated.

entities.name: Timer T3517
entities.description: Timer used during service request procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3525
entities.description: Timer started when service request attempt counter reaches 5, preventing further service requests.

entities.name: Timer T3447
entities.description: Timer that restricts service request initiation.

entities.name: Timer T3448
entities.description: Timer that restricts control plane service request initiation.

entities.name: Service Request Attempt Counter
entities.description: Counter tracking number of service request attempts.

entities.name: Emergency Services Fallback Condition
entities.description: Condition where service request is for emergency services fallback.

entities.name: High Priority Access Condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for high priority access.

entities.name: Emergency PDU Session Condition
entities.description: Condition where UE has or is establishing emergency PDU session.

entities.name: Paging or Notification Condition
entities.description: Condition where service request is in response to paging or network notification.

entities.name: Exception Data Reporting Condition
entities.description: Condition where UE in NB-N1 mode is allowed to transmit exception data.

entities.name: Access Barring Condition
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate access attempt is barred.

relations.description: Service request procedure involves sending SERVICE REQUEST message.
Service request procedure involves sending CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.
Service request procedure transitions UE to 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state.
Service request procedure starts timer T3517.
When service request attempt counter >= 5, UE starts timer T3525.
Emergency services fallback condition affects service request procedure behavior.
High priority access condition allows service request procedure during timer restrictions.
Emergency PDU session condition allows service request procedure during timer restrictions.
Paging or notification condition allows service request procedure during timer restrictions.
Exception data reporting condition allows service request procedure during timer restrictions.
Access barring condition prevents service request procedure initiation.
Running timer T3346 prevents service request procedure initiation except under specific conditions.
Running timer T3447 prevents service request procedure initiation except under specific conditions.
Running timer T3448 prevents control plane service request procedure initiation except under specific conditions.
UE enters 5GMM-REGISTERED state after service request procedure abortion in certain cases.
